configurations.name: budgetpro-live-PORT-MARKER-ONLY
configurations._comment: Port 3000 is owned by the LaunchAgent dev server (com.budgetpro.dev). Do NOT preview_start this entry — preview tooling cannot attach to a non-preview-owned port. Kept as a marker so a future Claude doesn't try to spin up a parallel server on :3000 (which would conflict per CLAUDE.md). Use curl + tail logs for live verification instead.
